body:
The Lodge Cast Iron Foundation will be auctioning off approximately 1400 items from the collection of beloved cast iron fan and collector Joel Schiff. After his death in 2015, Joel’s family donated thousands of pieces to the Lodge Cast Iron Foundation. Now, we're auctioning rare and antique iron from the collection to support the charitable mission of the Foundation.

The Lodge Cast Iron Foundation is committed to fostering strong communities by supporting initiatives that promote Culinary Education, Food Stability, and Community Development. The Lodge Foundation is the Lodge Cast Iron charitable entity, promoting projects that align with our legacy of craftsmanship, environmental responsibility, and Southern hospitality.

Auction to take place Friday, June 12 & Saturday, June 13

Join in person at 301 South Cedar Avenue, South Pittsburg, TN 37380 (ticket required). Or participate via simulcast online on AuctionZip.com (no ticket required).

The auction will be administered by Dinky’s Auction Center, ID #18776.

Tickets for in-person bidding include a free BBQ lunch, free entry to the Museum of Cast Iron, and a 10% discount to the Lodge Factory Store. Tickets can be purchased here: https://bit.ly/4bSGtwQ

Find additional details on the Lodge Cast Iron website here: https://bit.ly/4c70X3y
